column1: # moment<TAB>level<TAB>kind<TAB>text. Core data for scripts/mc-packet.sh, keyed by
# a closed set of moments (merge-recommendation, ready-flip, merge-intent) and
# by level (guided, standard); kind is lesson or recommend. Printed only when
# the cadence audit named a gap. Not an overlay catalog.

column4: A cadence step with no record means that review or check never ran on this exact change, so a problem it would catch can reach main unseen.
Close the gap before merging: run the missing step, record it, and re-check.
Marking a pull request ready tells reviewers and CI the work is finished; with a step missing, that claim is not yet true.
Close the gap before the pull request is marked ready.
Close the gap before marking it ready.
Merging with a step missing sends the change to main without that review, and an undone merge costs more than the step would have.
Close the gap first, then merge.
